review_description: I initially declined the quote for a second battery install from Solar4life even though it was cheapest, and went with another supplier who I had used for the previous installation. They were a lot more glitzy with a fleet of pretty trucks. That previous installer let me down and could not source stock for me, despite others being able to do so.Despite the fact that I had declined the Solar4Life offer and was not proceeding (at that time) with my installation, they continued to provide good advice and solved/fine tuned my existing system. They did this at the same time that the industry was melting down under the new battery “rebate”. And without prospect of any payment.Due to the Powerwall 2 failure I got a replacement battery. I returned to Solar4Life who somehow managed to provide me with a Powerwall 3 extension pack for my warranty replacement battery plus a new 14kW array (ie, an entirely new complete system) for little more than the other quotes I had received for just a second battery.They lack some of the glitz, but they do an excellent job and demonstrate customer service rather than just glossy rhetoric.

This was my second time dealing with Anil and the team from Solar4Life and I am very happy with the outcome again - I upgraded my panels and added a Tesla Powerwall 3 plus expansion pack.The quoting process was detailed and very accurate - the tool they use made it very clear what the system would look like and how it would perform.The installation was smooth and the team were punctual and friendly.The results are brilliant - highly recommend the Tesla PW3 - and really happy with the work that the team did.David

Received a number of quotes and Solar4Life was by far and away the best value for the same equipment being offered by other suppliers. Sales process and on site inspections were quick and thorough with good recommendations. Install was quick, efficient and well presented.Installed 15KW of solar, 24 KWH battery and a 22KW EV Charger.Have recommended to family and friends with the higher cost suppliers charging for extras that Solar4Life covered within their more cost effective quote.

Really couldn't be happier with our Sigenergy battery from Solar4Life.  Quoting was a breeze, price was competitive and the installation was professional and on time. Communication leading up to install was excellent and installers arrived on time and finished within the day and cleaned up well. Thanks Solar4Life, I would recommend and would use them again.

Got 4 quotes from Canberra companies with excellent solar quotes reviews for a battery to add AC Coupled to my 3 year old 17.2kWp SolarEdge system.Solar4Life not only came in with the best quote, but more importantly listened to my story and requests, came up with solutions that included home automation (Shelly’s and network cabling)… explaining the pros and cons of every option discussed.Anil was available every time I had a question or request.  Always happy to answer in detail.  His personal touch made the whole journey a pleasure.Installation team was professional, polite and informative.  Location of devices as planned, cable work great and often hidden, everything left neat and tidy.  Had a small issue with an inverter fan that was sorted out in a day with no fuss.Cant fault these guys.  Highly recommend.

From initial contact with Solar4Life to completion of the battery installation, the process was smooth and efficient.  I particularly appreciated two site visits to discuss how the battery and back-up gateway would be installed and how it would integrate with the existing solar/inverter system.  Installation was completed and commissioned expertly.  The whole team (sales, engineers, installers) kept me informed and were punctual at every stage.

Anil was great to deal with and suggestions were sensible allowing me to choose. Everything from quote to installation went smoothly. He worked around his schedule and arranged installations at a time that suited me and everything went as discussed. S4L was recommended to me by a couple of friends who had installations without any issues and my experience was also great and hassle-free. I would recommend them highly.

We were impressed with the service from start to finish. The installation went smoothly and the customer service provided by Ranjeet and Anil was excellent. We were pleasantly surprised by how stress free the whole process was! Thank you Solar4life!

Over the past 4 years Solar4Life have installed my solar system, ceiling insulation and most recently a 40kw battery and matching suitable inverter.  From start to finish the process for each job has been perfect!  The knowledge of the sale team is amazing - they were genuinely interested in finding me a solution for what I wanted, at a very good price point.  The team is always polite and professional.  Installation was on time and everything worked perfectly, with all of my questions answered and  site left clean and tidy.  I definitely recommend Solar4Life.

I worked with Anil, the business development manager, from the outset. I also had two other quotes, and Anil was most people friendly. He gave me all the advice leading to efficient overhaul of a system I had, including a 13 year old SMA micro inverter system which was beginning to slow down. Following his visit, I ended up with a 32 KWA Sigen system and a Sigen EVAC charger with nearly 20 kw solar panels on my roof (including what I already had). For the last three days even when sun is only partially visible, I am 99% on solar, including charging my Geely EX5. We have Sanden heat pump for water heating and heat pump air-conditioning throughout.Yes, we had small issues with inking the charger to the system but a visit by a keen helper sorted all out. I already had solar and all approvals were arranged without fuss and all my meter box connections and circuit breakers were upgraded to new AUNZ standard. All for the price equal to one of the other quotes I received which had no new panels or charger.They were polite, not trying to convince me that they are the best, punctual and kept the place tidy after all the work.I cannot be happier.

Dealing with Solar4Life Canberra has been a pleasure. From first contact through quoting, ordering, installation and commissioning of my Sigenergy system. Solar4Life has gone above and beyond being helpful. Communication has been good, the installation team were efficient and the quality of the installation is first class.

Anil was fantastic to work with. I made regular changes to my quote request, increasing the size of the batter each time, and Anil was happy to change the quote each time, responding quickly. The quote was very well priced. Fortunately I got in before the mad rush and was able to have the installation done in the first few days of July. The installation happened on the day it was planned for and virtually everything done that day. This system was fully functional that day. There were a couple of minor tasks remaining which were done two weeks later. I am very happy with my system and the quality installation job. I can definitely recommend Solar4Life.
I recently had a solar panel and battery package installed and have been very happy with the advice and service I received. Highly recommended.

I had 48kwh of sigenergy batteries installed, along with a 10 kw sig inverter and gateway, an EV charger, an istore heat pump HWS and a new induction cooktop. Solar4life staff were very knowledgeable and helpful. Best priced quote (by a significant amount) out of the three companies recommended by solarquotes website. Company owner was extremely helpful and flexible to changing requirements and I’m  glad that I followed his suggestion and installed sig batteries rather than BYD. The install staff were excellent, they were on-time, fast, professional and friendly and put in extra effort above the work that was quoted.  Overall a great experience and I highly recommend Solar4life.

The Sales proposal was very prompt and very responsive to changes required. The sales representative eas very professional and knowledgeable with comprehensive system and its installation based on my requirementsThe installation of the system happened on the date and time as was agreed. The installers were very friendly and executed the installation in a professional manner without any mess left.The customer service was very good and activated the live monitoring of the system within specified time without any hassel. The live monitoring is simple to use using the invertor mannufacturers app.I would recomend Solar4Life based on the service they have provided.

I contacted Solar4Life on a whim, pretty sure I was going to go with a quote from one of the big shiny company's that promote online. How absolutely, incredibly pleased I am that I didn't. Solar4Life did a like for like quote and were 10% cheaper (Powerwall 3, Solar, etc). Anil also provided alternate quotes for me, lots of different options, as I revised and revised what I wanted, he has the patience of a Zen master! Fast forward to when I eventually made up my mind, I was all ready to go and Labor announced their battery incentive. Anil immediately suggested we wait as it would be a massive saving for me (despite the massive hit to his cashflow). So I did. Now fast forward to 4th July, it's all installed and I just love it (more than one should love a metal box of electricity). The quality of install is absolutely without question, nothing, and I mean nothing was difficult for them. There were no extra charges. I even changed the location to inside my garage meaning a bollard, a hard wired smoke detector, longer wiring, no extra charge! One last example, we also got the DC EV charger installed,  I had noticed on Sigen's website that they were promoting an installer offer of buy 5 get 6th free. Thought not much of it. Just today, Anil sends the final invoice and it notes "20% discount on DC EV charger due supplier bonus". Honestly, you cannot fault Anil or the team came out, Jimmy, Babu, Saab, Goodchan and the others, thank you (and sorry for definitely misspelling your names). Oh, we're in Wollongong and they were happy to travel here.

Anil provided a competitive quote, did an on-site visit with his experienced panel installer (Saab) to verify layout before the final quote. The panel installers did a great job damaging only 1 tile for 42 panels, the Jimmy their electrician did a thorough and neat job with the sig 3phase inverter, stack and gateway.All in all, a very good experience from a great team.

I had an exceptional experience with Solar4Life from start to finish. Alasdair, my sales consultant, was professional, knowledgeable, and genuinely helpful throughout the entire process. He took the time to understand my energy usage and recommended a perfectly tailored system: a 40.3kWh battery setup with a 10kW Sigenergy SigenStor inverter.What impressed me most was the team's attention to detail — not just in system design, but also in handling all approvals, grid applications, and compliance paperwork without any hassle on my end. Everything, including the connection application and electrical certificate, was included in the price and clearly explained.The technology is cutting-edge, the system looks sleek, and the STC rebate was seamlessly applied, making the final cost very competitive. No hidden fees or upselling — just honest, high-quality service from a local Canberra team that clearly takes pride in their work.If you’re considering solar or battery storage, I strongly recommend Solar4Life. Ask for Alasdair — he’ll take great care of you!

I am absolutely thrilled with the excellent work that Solar4Life did in installing our solar system. Even when we encountered a problem with our system due to the work of another electrician, Anil Sah from Solar4Life went above and beyond by providing us with technical support on Christmas Day! Their dedication and professionalism are truly commendable. I highly recommend Solar4Life for anyone considering a solar installation.

The sales and quoting process with Solar4Life was straightforward and transparent. The team provided a detailed breakdown of the system components, including the REC Solar Alpha Pure-RX panels, Sigenergy SigenStor inverter, and battery, along with a clear explanation of the expected performance and savings. There was no pressure to make a quick decision, and all my questions were answered promptly.The installation team was punctual, polite, and highly professional. They took great care to ensure the installation was tidy, both on the roof and inside where the inverter, battery, and EV charger were installed. The team also ensured that the wiring and overall setup were clean and unobtrusive.Customer service was excellent throughout the process. After installation, Solar4Life assisted with organizing the grid connection and provided a thorough demonstration of how to monitor the system’s performance using the Sigenergy app. They also explained how to use the EV charger and manage the battery storage, which was a great addition to the system.

Competitive price compared to other providers; installation went on time with no delays. Depth technical knowledge of solar products. All queries were answered. We were kept informed throughout the process from start and end

Recently I had Solar4Life complete a 13.8kw solar system with 31 REC 460w panels and a Tesla powerwall 3 (with a Tesla EV charger, this was free as a part of a promotion!).Anil from Solar4Life was really good to deal with and very understanding as we delayed quite a few months to get the pw3 and the NSW rebate. There wasn’t any issues with the lead up or the install. There was a few small issues with panel positioning but was sorted on the day. They completed all the paperwork with the providers and everything was pretty simple. All work was completed in one day.  The Solar system was extremely competitively priced, in fact solar4life was the best quote out of the other competitors from the solarquotes and SolarHub, who have an excellent reputation in Canberra. I highly recommend Solar4Life.

We had a very good experience with Solar4Life. We dealt with a young man called Tai who was punctual and polite and patient with our many questions. We had other quotes and all of them were very good. Once we decided on the elements of the system, we asked all 3 companies to quote on the same system. Solar4Life offered the best price and were able to do the installation earlier than the other two.They did organise the changeover to a Smart Meter. We are asking for Tai to return to run us through some aspects that need clarification. That hasn't happened yet but I'm sure it will.

From getting the quote to installation the process ran quickly and smoothly.  Company was responsive to my requirements and were able to prepare a layout that suited the site and were flexible in changing it to meet my expressed needs.
Solar4life installed solar panels for my two properties in last September. So far so good. They are easy to reach out for any questions and offer advice. I’m happy with them.

It was a Friday afternoon when I told Anil to go ahead and try to ask him if he can install it the following week and he replied that we're going to do it tomorrow. OMG the following day they put 30 panels in our roof. We are happy of the overall installation. Anil and the whole team deserve TEN stars.RonaldChifley,  ACT

I recently had a solar panel system installed at my home, and I couldn’t be more thrilled with the results! The entire process, from the initial consultation to the final installation, was seamless and professional. The team provided clear and detailed explanations of the benefits and the installation process, ensuring I felt confident every step of the way.The installation crew arrived on time and worked efficiently, completing the project ahead of schedule. They were courteous, respectful of my property, and left the site clean and tidy. The quality of the work is outstanding, and the panels look fantastic on my roof.Since the installation, I’ve already noticed a significant reduction in my energy bills, and it feels great to be contributing to a more sustainable future. The monitoring system they provided allows me to track my energy production in real time, which is both fascinating and reassuring.I highly recommend this company to anyone considering solar energy. Their expertise, professionalism, and commitment to customer satisfaction are truly top-notch. It’s one of the best investments I’ve made for my home and the environment.
A very smooth start to end process. Job was completed in a day and very well coordinated and completed as per timeline provided.
My solar installation process was quick, value for budget and whole process was easy.
Quick installation and Very Friendly, helpful, quick response, and knowledgeable
Easy to deal, genuine explanation and best suited system design and Installation.

Anil from Solar4life came out to survey the house and provided us the best quote, advice and discuss the needs. Not many companies visit onsite for quotes these days but these people know how to look after the customer professionally.Service provided by Anil and his team was Exemplary! Solar system installed in timely manner just within 2 days after we accepted the quote. Install team was very efficient, respectful and professional. Well done and thank you.

Quoting process was really good - no pressure tactics and I got so speak to a real human being from the beginning, and included a site visit as well, so we could go through various options face to face.The installation went really well - there was a little confusion about the date, but that was quickly and readily rectified, which to me speaks to a company that wants to deliver a great service and is very responsive to its clients.I have had some horror experiences in the past with solar installations (not in the ACT), and was incredibly anxious about the whole process and what would be expected of me in terms of dealing with third parties or subcontractors, but I really did not have to do anything other than deal directly with Solar4Life.  All connected including grid connection so I am now seeing the benefits of my new system - massive relief!!!!!
Very competitive price, good customer service and professional at all times.Installation and set up was smooth
We have used Solar4Life twice now for different properties and they do a really good job. Good communication and structure along with very competitive pricing.

I had a positive experience with Solar4life. Their pricing was competitive, and the installation was done with precision. The customer service was excellent, with prompt responses to all my inquiries. They stuck to the schedule, completing the installation on time. Overall, I highly recommend Solar4life for their value, customer service, quality installation, and punctuality.

We are very impressed with the professionalism and level of service provided by Anil and his team.The team inspected our roof prior to the quote which took away any guess work with how many panels we could install.Anil helped us with contextually navigating through the pros and cons associated with the various types of systems, which ultimately helped us make a decision. I would highly recommend Anil and the team.

I couldn't be more delighted with the exceptional service provided by Solar4Life. From start to finish, their team demonstrated professionalism, expertise, and a genuine commitment to customer satisfaction. The installation process was seamless, thanks to their knowledgeable staff who guided me through every step of the way. They carefully assessed my energy needs, provided valuable recommendations, and tailored a solution that perfectly suited my requirements. Not only did they deliver on time, but the quality of their workmanship exceeded my expectations. They also went above and beyond to ensure that everything was completed to my satisfaction. The solar panels they installed are not only efficient but also seamlessly integrated into my home's aesthetics. Additionally, their after-sales support has been outstanding, promptly addressing any queries or concerns I've had. I highly recommend Solar4Life to anyone looking to make the switch to solar energy. They are truly top-notch in their field! I took the relation a notch up and got two of my other properties converted to solar by them.

- Of the 3 quotes, Solar4Life was the most prompt to offer site visit to complete a quote. The came through with second lowest price, but I chose them over cheaper quote, since they did the site visit.- The installation took a bit longer than planned. The original location to install the powerwall was changed on the day. this was a good thing, as the original quote didn't consider car port, due to proximity to windows of house. But this wasn't an issue (it was far enough away from window) and this ended up being the best location for it. The two main installers (external electrical contractors who did the work on behalf of Solar4Life) came across as flustered and didn't exude confidence in their approach to the install. In the end, everything worked as expected, but there was plenty of swearing and "hissy fits" in between.- Customer service was good. They were responsive to questions or emails.

I recently installed a 26.4kW solar system from Solar4life, and I am absolutely thrilled with the results. The package I chose included the balance of system, labor, and installation, encompassing panel mounting kits, electrical components, roof flashings, and the necessary labor. The specific components featured in my system are the Jinko Solar Tiger Neo JKM440N-54HL4R-V (440W) panels, totaling 60 units, and the Fronius Symo 20.0-3-M inverter (20kW).What initially caught my attention was Solar4life's recommendation for a larger system, unlike some other suggestions I received for smaller setups with batteries. This turned out to be a game-changer, as my system now consistently generates over 150KW of power. The decision to go bigger has proven to be incredibly wise, and I am reaping the rewards in the form of substantial credits from ActewAGL.Not only am I thrilled to be contributing to a cleaner environment, but the financial benefits have surpassed my expectations. Thanks to Solar4life, I no longer have to worry about energy bills. In fact, I'm consistently in credit with ActewAGL, making my energy expenses a thing of the past.The Jinko Solar panels and Fronius inverter have been performing exceptionally well, showcasing the reliability and quality of Solar4life's offerings. The installation process was smooth, and the team's expertise was evident throughout. I appreciate the attention to detail in including all the necessary components for a comprehensive solar solution.In summary, I highly recommend Solar4life for anyone considering a solar installation. Their insightful recommendations, top-notch components, and impeccable service have not only made me energy-independent but also put me in a position to enjoy financial benefits for years to come. Kudos to Solar4life for delivering a system that goes above and beyond expectations!

I  live in Bungendore NSW and had a Solar4Life 13.2 kWDC (STC) system installed using30 × 440W Jinko Solar Tiger Neo panels and aSungrow SH10RT · 10000W inverter Three phase ·98.4%max. efficiency and aSungrow SBR160 modular battery 16kWh (16kWh usable) · Lithium IonThe east/west system has been up and running for a month and I am very pleased with the results. From monitoring the system on the iSolarCloud app I have used hardly any power from the grid. If the battery drops to 80% by sunrise it is fully charged again by about 9 a.m.I had a number of quotes from different companies and the price didn’t vary a whole lot between them. What made me choose Solar4Life was the patience of their general manager Anil in explaining how it all worked and refining the plan a number of times to meet my needs. I visited their warehouse and saw how they operate.The installers were easy to work with and all were employees of the company and not contractors.  They did a good job and cleaned up well when they were finished. I was very impressed with their electrician. Besides hooking up everything including an EV charging cable, he installed the battery below the inverter in the garage with enough room to add to the modular battery in case I think I need it come winter. Solar4Life organised the grid connection with no effort on my part.All in all, a very positive experience and I haven’t hesitated to recommend them to good friends.

After using SolarQuotes to source companies to provide quotes for the new place we were moving into, Anil from Solar4Life was the first to contact me. We met via an online meeting and he discussed different options and provided 5 system designs he felt would best suit the residence. Having had a Fronius and Tesla at the old place I was keen to stay with what I knew worked well, and he provided a competitive quote with a number of options.The sales process was good, after the initial discussion, there was no super pushy sales pitches, a coupe of companies I was quoted by, rang and emailed every day trying to get my business, which I don't like! Anil came out onsite and looked at the residence (the only company that offered this as we are rural), and confirmed location of all equipment, made sure I was happy with where it would all be fitted.The next challenge was to get it fitted prior to the New year, which he achieved, the first date fell through as the electrician did not arrive at work, this was quickly rectified and the system was installed and up and running prior to the new year, a very quick turn around. The install went pretty well, a couple of reminders to the installers not to cut metal on the roof as we are on tank water, which they accommodated, and on completion of the job they cleaned the site and took all the rubbish away. Anil came out to ensure the commissioning of the system was achieved and ensured I was happy with everything, great service!Currently waiting to have the meter changed over, but Anil pre booked this prior to install to ensure it would happen as quickly as possible.

Responded to my request for quote quickly and provided a very detailed quote. Kept me in the loop regarding the process and installed the system within 2 weeks of me accepting the quote. The installers were punctual,  quick and neat

All the problems have now been resolved but it was I that pointed them out.Part of the solar array wasn't connected to the system correctly (7/29 panels not connected) but Solar4life said to wait a week and maybe it was cloudy weather it wasn't generating at capacity. Finally got them to fix after a week.2nd problem was our roof leaked after a big storm due to the install. They were very hard to get hold of who was coming and when it was going to be fixed. It was fixed in the end and isn't leaking since.I'm still happy with the system and the quoted price.
The sales/quoting process was extremely fast & comprehensive.The installation went on time without a hitch.Impeccable Customer Service. Hard to find this kind of service these days!

Selecting, designing and installing the solar system and heat pump with Anil and his team at Solar4Life was a highly informative and pleasurable experience. Anil’s breadth of knowledge and patience in walking us through the available options was exemplary – no sales-pitch or push for particular brands, carefully explaining options (several times over), outlining pros and cons of different combinations of panels and inverters, helped our decision process over about a week. Solar4Life offered the best quote compared with comparable systems from 4 other companies. The installation was punctual as promised, and went smoothly for the very professional, polite and friendly installation team.

Solar4Life were responsive from start to finish. Their advice was honest and aligned to a lot of the research I was doing myself. At the helm of this company is a general manager with a lot of passion for the industry and the work that they do, this shines through in the time he is willing to spend with clients to really explain the pros and cons of the systems they are quoting. He even went as far as coming out to my place on his day off after the install to enable a feature on my inverter that had been disabled by default. He also spent the time with me to test the monitoring of the system, which involved testing multiple appliances while he re-checked electrical work. As far as the actual system goes, it's performing well so far, especially with the cloud cover we have been having.

This was an addition to our existing 3 phase, microinverter based 13 kW system, putting an extra 5.7 kW  on various parts of the roof to try and pick up more early morning and late afternoon sun. Solar4Life did our original install and we've been happy with the performance* and service so we went with them again. We back and forthed several designs before settling on the final layout and they were very helpful,and quick turning them around.The timeline they provided for the installation process was accurate, and the install itself was done very quickly on the day. They did the behind the scenes magic to make the new components show up on the Enphase app, so I can now spend my retirement watching the numbers.*La Nina became quite apparent after the initial installation, and now the new install seems to be about to precipitate a week or more of rain. Coincidence?

Excellent service from the get go.Straight up competitive quote, prompt site visit and quick installation. This was just for a second PW2We always appreciate Tradesmen that communicate, roll up on time and leave our place neat and tidy.Appreciate the follow up call to confirm we were happy with the install. Highly recommended.

Solar4Life has very professional staff that provide excellent services. Can you imagine entire solar system was designed and installed in a day and ready to produce power in the afternoon. Highly recommend for any solar system related services and products.

From the time the first contact was made it was smooth sailing. The end to end process was seamless. Customer service and follow up remarkable.We were also recommended by our neighbour to go Solar 4life as they too were highly satisfied with their serviceVery good service overall

I obtained three quotes, Solar4Life was in the middle. The much more expensive quote was not worth the money as Solar4Life’s panels and inverter had better specifications than them and so the products were more than comparable.I also found the company very responsive. They replied promptly to my queries re the products used etc, re the installation and right up to actual installation and post installation. Not very often do you get a call from the MD asking whether everything was done to our satisfaction.
The team at Solar4Life were fantastic. From initial contact and quoting through to scheduling and installing, the team had great communication and advice. Installation was efficient and well done.
Solar4life provided a reasonable quotation and installed panels and batteries in a short time period. I am very satisfied with their quick response and also for the nice customer support.

I must admit it's a nightmare going through this process and there are indeed some cowboys out there!  After getting about 6 quotes, we settled on Solar4Life due to their quality of product - NON CHINESE made panels (REC 410w made in Singapore) and a Sungrow controller - total nearly 6.6kw.There was a hickup with one of the subcontractors working without proper PPE (tethers) and worksafe shut down the site mid install.  Different subbies attended and completed the install and all in all very happy with the quality of their work.Despite the drama, I would highly recommend Solar4Life.

Highly professional and recommend them with 5 star rating. True pleasure to work with Anil and I ended up with the different spec than what initially I thought of due to our discussion on efficiency and future proof system. During this process I called up Anil many times and he always responded and explained everything patiently. Even I visited to his Mitchell office and spend 3 hrs to design my system with so many back and forth discussion due to product, pricing and value for money. Anil played critical role in optimising the system and fulfilled my requirement. He kept me updated with the progress, all paperwork went smooth and installation done by team of professionals. I've already recommended couple of my friends and would highly recommend to anyone in future. A bunch of good people who knows their stuff and advise honestly.

I recently had a solar installation done in my house by SOLAR4LIFE, and I couldn't be happier with their service. From start to finish, they were extremely professional and punctual. The entire process was seamless, and the team displayed great expertise. My solar panels are now up and running smoothly, and I'm already seeing the benefits in my energy bills. I highly recommend SOLAR4LIFE, for their outstanding work!

Anil, Jimmy and other team helped us to have solar installed at our home from the beginning of process of 3P upgrade till it’s completed. They are very professional in their expertise as well as customer service. I feel comfortable to bring up my concern to them as they’re very responsive.

Sales process was informative and not pushy. Advised right product that suited my requirement.Installation went smooth and team worked on a Sunday in order to enable the service.Anil and his team are good bunch of guys.I would definitely recommend them.

We have had our solar system installed for a month or so now. So far all is going well and the panels look good. We haven't received a power bill yet so it is too early to tell how well the system works for us. Solar4Life were careful with the installation of panels and the inverter and they always responded quickly and politely to my questions or concerns during the quoting process. I organised several quotes and did my own research. Solar4Life offered a competitive price for what I wanted. They also came back to assist with grid connection after the install. My only advice to others is to carefully assess and agree on the placement of the inverter prior to the day of installation so there are no unexpected surprises. All went well for us but we did have to change the inverter placement on the day of installation.

Tradies were very efficient and polite. Were told solar would be up and running before Christmas but that didn’t happen. Not very good on Solar 4 Life’s part . Alisdair also changed plans where to put panels. He told us we would have 12 panels on top roof and 4 on a lower roof. Changed plans at very last minute. Ended putting all 16 on top roof. Not what we really wanted but too late as Tradies had already started work . Anyhow thanks for what you have done for us. Have a happy Christmas.Cheers. Rodney

All went smoothly. Helpful suggestions about panel locations.Unfortunately the installation seemed to bring on La Nina, so the estimated power output has been a bit under due to extremely cloudy weather.

Excellent pricing and good customer service up front. Nathan was very patient answering all my questions.Installation was disorganised and a bit lengthy, but this may have been largely beyond Solar4Life's control - I understand that combination of rain, covid infections and shipping issues meant there was a significant backlog.  They ended up getting in contractors, including from interstate, to manage backlog, which created own problems.  There was some problems with the work of the contractor who installed a larger meter box, however Simon from Solar4Life responded quickly to this and rectified promptly.  Simon's communication was great.

Although the system has not been installed yet, Solar4Life was responsive  and provided a 7.65kW design that fully met my needs - which was for more PV rather than fastest payback. The quote was very timely and the sales rep was well trained and knowledgeable. Also had the patience to work through alternatives. The ACT Sustainable Household Scheme is excellent and very user friendly, with rapid approval in my case (within a day).

We had some technical issues that came up after the solar panel being installed couple of years back.  We have contacted solar for life team,  the action was quick.  They sent the tech team next day itself.  They stayed back for the day with us and resolved the issue.  Hope this service will be given to rest of the community.  Im sure the team will look after us too. Thanks and best of luck.

Quoting process was at the house and well explained.Installation was professional, punctual, staff very polite,courteousThe system was already connected to grid.
